# On and off by default — the `deps` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#deps).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** a root `package.json` or `pyproject.toml`.
- **Rules:** 8 — 0 on, 8 on with `preview = true`, 0 off in an opt-in preset, 0 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `deps/recommended` | yes, once the pack is installed | 8 | 3 error, 1 info, 4 warn | Vulnerable, outdated and wrongly licensed dependencies of package.json and pyproject.toml, from the committed snapshot `codelaw deps refresh` writes |

## Rules

`on` runs in a fresh install; a `preview` rule runs only with `preview = true` ([SR-RULE-PACKS](../../../records/0101_rule-packs.md) decision 9). † a preset `init` writes only when the repo has what it is for.

| Rule | By default | Severity | Preset |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`deps/incomplete-scan`](../deps/incomplete-scan.md) | on with `preview = true` | warn | `deps/recommended` |
| [`deps/licence`](../deps/licence.md) | on with `preview = true` | error | `deps/recommended` |
| [`deps/lockfile-sync`](../deps/lockfile-sync.md) | on with `preview = true` | error | `deps/recommended` |
| [`deps/outdated`](../deps/outdated.md) | on with `preview = true` | warn | `deps/recommended` |
| [`deps/runtime-agreement`](../deps/runtime-agreement.md) | on with `preview = true` | warn | `deps/recommended` |
| [`deps/stale-snapshot`](../deps/stale-snapshot.md) | on with `preview = true` | info | `deps/recommended` |
| [`deps/version-drift`](../deps/version-drift.md) | on with `preview = true` | warn | `deps/recommended` |
| [`deps/vulnerable`](../deps/vulnerable.md) | on with `preview = true` | error | `deps/recommended` |
